product.name: TROTTEN desk sit/stand (electric)
product.introText: TROTTEN desk sit/stand, electric, white, 120x70 cm (71-118 cm, max 50 kg). Assembly AA-2746846 (simplified: legs pre-assembled, beam in one piece), hand controller AA-2637190. When assembled, press "Use it" to drive the desk.
product.partsSummary: 1x Beam,  4x Bscrew,  1x Control box,  2x Foot,  8x Fscrew,  1x Handset,  2x Leg,  1x Top,  8x Tscrew

steps.title: Feet
steps.text: Lay out the two feet, left (L) and right (R).

steps.title: Legs
steps.text: Stand each telescopic leg on its foot and fix it with 4 screws using the Allen key.

steps.title: Cross beam
steps.text: Lay the cross beam (with the drive shaft inside) between the two leg tops.

steps.title: Beam screws
steps.text: Fix the beam to both legs with 2 screws each.

steps.title: Control box
steps.text: Clip the control box under the cross beam and plug the motor cables in.

steps.title: Table top
steps.text: Two people: lay the table top on the frame, centred, with the holes over the leg arms.

steps.title: Fix the top
steps.text: Screw the table top to the leg arms from below, 4 screws per side.

steps.title: Hand controller
steps.text: Screw the hand controller under the front edge of the top (right side) and plug its cable into the control box. Plug the desk in.
